# Healthcare Administrators

This folder catalogs individuals who hold administrative, governance, and data oversight roles within Denmark's national clinical quality databases and regional health programs. The pages here document key figures responsible for ensuring data compliance, registration processes, and operational governance, such as steering committee members and primary contacts for health authorities. By tracking these administrators, the wiki maps the institutional oversight and data responsibility structures that underpin clinical registries like the Acute Surgery Database.

## Pages

- [[birgitte-ruhmann|Birgitte Rühmann]] — Head nurse and RKKP Knowledge Center representative who acts as the primary contact for data responsibility, compliance, and operational oversight in the acute surgery database.
